decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would result in the loss of a family unit which the Council considers to be suitable for continued residential use in order to help meet the demand for such accommodation in the borough, contrary to the intent of the NPPF, London Plan policies H1, H8, H9 and Local Plan policies SC1, SC3 and GB6.

Condition : 2 - The proposal fails to carry out a sequential assessment to prove that there are no available sites for a new visitor accommodation in these the nearby town centres, edge-of-town-centre locations or large neighbourhood centres for short term visitor accommodation and fails to confirm that the vitality and vibrancy of the town centres would not be harmed, contrary to intent of the NPPF, London Plan policies GG2, E10, SD6 and Local Plan policies TC4, ED3.

Condition : 3 - The proposal fails to demonstrate how the proposed development will avoid any adverse impact on the amenity of neighbouring residents due to the increased activity with comings and goings leading to greater noise and disturbances within the building and neighbourhood. In addition, the site is not suitable to provide accommodation for up to 6 people as suggested as the bedroom sizes and unit area are not in compliance with NDSS. The proposal is therefore contrary to Local Plan Policies CC2, ED3, EQ5, SC5, London Plan policies E10, D5, D6 and NPPF.

Condition : 4 - The proposal has failed to consider flood risk impacts arising through the proposed change of use and, in particular, has failed to demonstrate that flood risk has been considered at the design stages of the proposal, contrary to Local Plan Policy EQ3 and the National Planning Policy Framework.

Reason : 1 - The proposal would result in the loss of a family unit which the Council considers to be suitable for continued residential use in order to help meet the demand for such accommodation in the borough. Therefore the proposal is contrary to the intent of the NPPF, London Plan policies H1, H8, H9 and Local Plan policies SC1, SC3 and GB6.

Reason : 2 - The proposal fails to carry out a sequential assessment to prove that there are no available sites for a new visitor accommodation in the nearby town centres, edge-of-town-centre locations or large neighbourhood centres for short term visitor accommodation and fails to confirm that the vitality and vibrancy of the town centres would not be harmed, contrary to intent of the NPPF, London Plan policies GG2, E10, SD6 and Local Plan policies TC4, ED3.

Reason : 3 - The proposal fails to demonstrate how the proposed development will avoid any adverse impact on the amenity of neighbouring residents due to the increased activity with comings and goings leading to greater noise and disturbances within the vicinity and neighbourhood of the site. In addition, the site is not suitable to provide accommodation for up to 6 people as suggested as the bedroom sizes and unit area are not in compliance with NDSS. The proposal is therefore contrary to Local Plan Policies CC2, ED3, EQ5, SC5, London Plan policies E10, D5, D6 and NPPF.

Reason : 4 - The proposal has failed to consider flood risk impacts arising through the proposed change of use and, in particular, has failed to demonstrate that flood risk has been considered at the design stages of the proposal, contrary to Local Plan Policy EQ3 and the National Planning Policy Framework.
description: Change of use of an existing residential mooring containing one permanently moored vessel from Class C3 to short term visitor accommodation, holiday lets operating for more than 90 nights per calendar year.
